items.headline: AI models are learning to “reproduce”, without training

items.excerpt: A Ghaziabad MP-MLA court has issued a Non-Bailable Warrant (NBW) against Nagina MP and Azad Samaj Party chief Chandra Shekhar Azad, along with orders to attach his property. The court issued the warrant after Azad repeatedly failed to appear for scheduled hearings and remained absent during proceedings. In 2018, Chandra Shekhar Azad and his supporters allegedly assaulted and threatened a man at a Ghaziabad wedding after he questioned them for carrying weapons.
